summary: You made a good start with a clear reef-monitoring idea benefiting Australia, named users, and a workable weekly plan with sources and STK preparation. To progress, quantify mission requirements and add mission-specific technical analysis to guide your full design.
next_steps: Quantify your Mission Concept & Rationale requirements for resolution, revisit over the reef area, coverage and latency, and address bleaching-detection constraints.
Strengthen your Project Plan & Preliminary Progress Gantt by tailoring tasks to the reef payload, justifying fit to the concept, and adding contingency time.
Generate your mission-specific STK outputs or orbit/communications/deorbit calculations, define AOEs, caption your figure, and match Useful Links to in-text citations.

criteria.C1: You did well in Mission Concept & Rationale to explain Australian benefit for the Great Barrier Reef and name users like marine and conservation scientists to predict bleaching. For Accomplished, add formal goals, objectives and quantified requirements for resolution, revisit over 344400 km2, latency, and link function to user needs with literature.
criteria.C2: You provided a feasible weekly Gantt chart in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress and a Useful Links source list including NOAA bleaching work. For Accomplished, tailor tasks to reef payload needs, explain why the sequence fits your mission concept, and add provision for variations and contingencies with information sources tied to plan.
criteria.C3: You noted completing STK tutorials 1-4 in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress, which shows initiative. For Adequate, show minor mission-specific progress with orbit/COE, communications or deorbit calculations or STK outputs for reef coverage, define AOEs, and briefly interpret results.
criteria.C4: You wrote readably with headings in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress. For Accomplished, number and caption your Gantt chart figure, make formatting consistent, and replace bare URLs in Useful Links with properly cited in-text references that match the list.
